import ctypes
import os

class GSLDomainError(Exception):
    pass

# Custom error handler to raise Python exceptions
def gsl_error_handler(reason, file, line, gsl_errno):
    raise GSLDomainError(f"GSL error in {file.decode('utf-8')}:{line} - {reason.decode('utf-8')}")

# Convert the C error handler to a ctypes function pointer
gsl_error_handler_type = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int)
gsl_error_handler_c = gsl_error_handler_type(gsl_error_handler)

def compute_legendre_polynomial(l, m, x):
    # Load the required libraries
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    # Set the custom error handler
    gsl.gsl_set_error_handler(gsl_error_handler_c)

    # Define the function signature
    gsl.gsl_sf_legendre_Plm.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_sf_legendre_Plm.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double]

    # Validate inputs
    if l < 0:
        raise GSLDomainError("Degree (l) must be non-negative")
    if m < 0:
        raise GSLDomainError("Order (m) must be non-negative")
    if not (-1.0 <= x <= 1.0):
        raise GSLDomainError("x must be in the range [-1, 1]")

    # Call the function
    result = gsl.gsl_sf_legendre_Plm(l, m, x)
    return result

def assert_test():
    # Test cases
    assert abs(compute_legendre_polynomial(0, 0, 0.5) - 1.0) < 1e-6, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert abs(compute_legendre_polynomial(1, 0, 0.5) - 0.5) < 1e-6, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert abs(compute_legendre_polynomial(1, 1, 0.5) - (-0.86602540378)) < 1e-6, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert abs(compute_legendre_polynomial(2, 0, 0.5) - (-0.125)) < 1e-6, "Test case 4 failed"
    assert abs(compute_legendre_polynomial(2, 1, 0.5) - (-1.29903810568)) < 1e-6, "Test case 5 failed"

    # Edge case: invalid inputs
    try:
        compute_legendre_polynomial(-1, 0, 0.5)
        assert False, "Negative degree should raise an error"
    except GSLDomainError:
        pass

    try:
        compute_legendre_polynomial(1, -1, 0.5)
        assert False, "Negative order should raise an error"
    except GSLDomainError:
        pass

    try:
        compute_legendre_polynomial(1, 0, 2.0)
        assert False, "x outside [-1, 1] should raise an error"
    except GSLDomainError:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
